MapTiler | Remote (Europe) | Full-time | https://www.maptiler.com

We build mapping infrastructure and rendering engines for hundreds of millions of users. Currently developing a new WebGPU SDK for 3D geospatial visualization.

Hiring: WebGPU SDK Developer

• Implementation of GPU-accelerated rendering (shaders, pipelines, buffers).

• Work on high-performance visualizations, including Gaussian splatting.

• Agile environment (2-week sprints), direct impact on core rendering tech.

Stack: WebGPU, JavaScript/TypeScript, GPU shaders, Vulkan/Metal concepts.

Apply: https://www.maptiler.com/jobs/
